title: Isodiametric normalisation: μHE[n] ≤ (ω_n/2ⁿ)·μH[n]
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, the Euclidean Hausdorff measure μHE[n] on ℝ^P (Mathlib: μHE[n] = c_n·μH[n] with c_n = addHaarScalarFactor(volume on ℝⁿ, μH[n])) satisfies μHE[n] ≤ (ω_n/2ⁿ)·μH[n] as measures (setwise), where ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝⁿ and μH[n] is Mathlib's Hausdorff measure with weight diamⁿ. Equivalently c_n ≤ ω_n/2ⁿ, i.e. Hⁿ = μHE[n] is dominated by Simon's normalisation ω_n(diam/2)ⁿ (Simon Ch. 1, 2.1–2.2).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) ≤ (unitBallVolume n / 2 ^ n) • (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Euclid P))
